subject: Retention approval request — Nimbus Labs: SLA addendum + credit package
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Retention approval request — Nimbus (DEAL-009482)

Team —

Short version: Nimbus (current ARR $1.6M) is threatening to move to a competitor unless we approve a concession package. Renewal is 03/31. They cite recent latency incidents in us-west and want stronger contractual SLAs plus a one-time credit to offset migration costs. Without movement I expect churn or a significant net-new discount request.

Proposed concession package (what I can sign if approved by execs):
- One-time customer credit: $160,000 (10% of ARR) to be applied on renewal invoice.
- Contract term reset: 12 months starting on renewal date (they want annual).
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime commitment for inference endpoints in us-west region with a capped credit schedule (outlined in attached draft).
- Concierge onboarding budget: $25k professional services credit (to cover migration/licensing friction).

Business reason: Nimbus is strategic for our marketplace case studies and references in fintech analytics. They have pilot workloads that expand compute spend if we stabilize latency. Churn would be high impact for Q2 ARR and would signal reliability issues to prospects in that vertical.

Risks / ask: This is outside standard deal desk thresholds (credits > $50k and SLA changes require legal & exec signoff). Requesting approval to offer the package above. If we can’t land this, ask is permission to offer a smaller alternative (5% one-time credit + no SLA addendum) to keep them engaged while we remediate.

Attachments: Nimbus_Renewal_SUMMARY.pdf, SLA_addendum_draft.docx, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Next step: Please reply with Approve / Deny / Need more info. If Approve, legal can finalize redlines — I’ve copied Laura.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0189
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention approval request — Nimbus (DEAL-009482)

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple of quick clarifying Qs before I take this up:
1) Can you confirm current commitment / renewal amount versus ARR you quoted? I have $1.6M ARR but renewal quote shows $1.4M recurring (some modules sunsetting).
2) The SLA addendum looks reasonable in principle — can Laura confirm legal risk on the credit cap language?
3) Do we have an exec reference / escalation path if they push for multi-region SLAs?

Assuming renewal net dollar retention is >80% and there’s reasonable upside, I’m inclined to approve the one-time credit and PS credit; the 99.9% SLA addendum needs legal sign-off and product sign-off for operational feasibility. Ben — can you weigh in on margin impact if we waive $160k against Q2 bookings?

If we can get answers today I’ll push this to RevOps/CEO queue for a fast decision.

-M

—
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Retention approval request — Nimbus (DEAL-009482)

Marissa — quick follow with the details you asked for.

1) Numbers: Current committed ARR: $1.6M. Renewal invoice (base product only) would be $1.44M for the renewed term without concessions. Customer is asking for a 20% off equivalent; our proposed one-time credit ($160k) preserves list pricing while providing the offset they need.
2) Legal: Laura — draft SLA has a capped credit schedule (first occurrence: 5% credit up to $30k; subsequent incidents escalate per schedule up to 45 days credit cap). The cap prevents open-ended liability. I’ve asked legal to confirm but included conservative caps in the draft.
3) Ops/Product: Stephanie — the 99.9% single-region commitment is operationally achievable if we add cross-region failover for their core endpoints; there will be a modest uplift in runcosts (estimated incremental $9k/month) — I can absorb this in the ARR retention calculus but want Product to sign off on timeline and runbook.

Customer signals: Aisha (Procurement) flagged a competitor briefing last week and said final decision will be made mid-March unless we move quickly. Tom (engineering sponsor) prefers the SLA addendum.

If you’re comfortable with $160k credit + PS credit + SLA draft, can you mark Approve and I’ll route to legal for final redlines and to RevOps for accounting?

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Retention approval request — Nimbus (DEAL-009482)

Vivek / Marissa —

Approve the proposed package as written: $160k one-time credit, $25k PS credit, 12-month term reset, SLA addendum (99.9% us-west) with capped credit schedule.

Accounting note: Treat $160k as one-time contra-revenue applied at renewal; RevOps to confirm recognition timing but we can structure as a renewal incentive. Margin hit is acceptable given churn risk and reference value — flagged to finance.

Laura/Legal & Stephanie/Product — please prioritize finalizing the SLA language and ops runbook. Vivek, once legal signs off, get DocuSign link ready and confirm we have the internal PS allocation for a March onboarding window.

Ben Carter
Senior Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
